title: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope
summary: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope is NASA's next flagship astrophysics mission, featuring a 2.4-meter mirror and wide-field infrared instrument to study dark energy, search for exoplanets, and conduct wide-area surveys of the universe. Named after NASA's first Chief of Astronomy, this mission complements James Webb while focusing on cosmic expansion mysteries and planetary discovery.
problem_solved: Advances understanding of dark energy, dark matter, and searches for habitable exoplanets through wide-field infrared surveys of the universe.
why_valuable: As a Hubble-class space telescope with revolutionary wide-field capability, Roman will map billions of galaxies, discover thousands of exoplanets, and help resolve cosmic mysteries that current telescopes cannot address at this scale.
